cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may borrow my ladder until Friday. Leave your shadow with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need it at work. Could you take something else?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep its office hours. I'll have the evenings. Those are the terms; the ladder is yours when you agree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Could you hold it too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll hold both until you're down. You can collect the fear afterward if you still want it.
